info.name: vLLM Cloud E2E - API, Cache & Guardrails (40 requests)
info.description: Cloud E2E regression suite for LiteLLM -> guardrail -> vLLM. Run folders in order. Exact/semantic seed requests generate a unique vLLM seed so their first lookup is a deterministic cache MISS even when Redis already contains similar questions. Keep the API key in Postman's Current value; do not commit it.
